stem_book: A ball of mass m is released from rest in a smooth circular tube of radius R (vertical plane), at the level of the centre. A spring of spring constant k, which is in its natural length, is placed in the tube as shown in figure (filling the arc from the ball down to the lowest point). If the angle made by the radius vector of the ball with the vertical when the ball comes to an instantaneous rest is 60°, then the value of k is (a) 9mg/(π²R) (b) 18mg/(π²R) (c) 36mg/(π²R) (d) 72mg/(π²R)
reason: Start position (level of centre) and smooth tube made explicit from the figure.
work: arc compression = R(π/6) ; drop = R cos60° = R/2 ; mgR/2 = (1/2)k(πR/6)² → k = 36mg/(π²R)
